x: Examples are Trevor Wright 59th, Mike Turner 25th and 38th, Mike Baxter 35th and 31st and Mike Tagg 32nd. By placing between 21st and 77th our Youths have shown they are following in distinguished footsteps.
In third place will be T. Wright, who will run rather above himself.
Once again, Gerry showed his capacity to rise to the occasion, covering the near 7½-miles course in 35m. 42s., against 35m. 04s. by the winner, Trevor Wright, of Hallamshire and Yorkshire.

Pride of place goes to Trevor Wright (Wolv. & Bilston) for a 2:12.32 at Fukuoke (Japan) 1 sec. ahead of Tony Simmons (Luton). At the other end we get four, five and even six hour efforts in the "Masters and Maidens" event.
